faqs.a: SpotSign AI is an enterprise Workforce Operating System (WOS) that unifies Core HR/HRIS, workforce management, biometric attendance, payroll, Indian statutory compliance, talent acquisition, performance, learning, finance/General Ledger, IT asset management, and workforce analytics on one platform.

faqs.q: How is SpotSign AI different from traditional HRMS platforms like Keka or Workday?
faqs.a: Traditional HRMS systems primarily record employee information and process standard salaried payroll. SpotSign AI operates as an end-to-end Workforce Operating System connecting People, Work, Money, IT Operations, and Workforce Analytics. It uniquely supports both corporate salaried employees and variable-wage/blue-collar industrial workforces (piece-rate, daily-rate, shift-allowances), integrates directly with General Ledger accounting, provides an embedded Workforce Planning simulator, and includes 19 pre-built industry vertical packs.

faqs.q: What is a Workforce Operating System (WOS)?
faqs.a: A Workforce Operating System is an enterprise software platform that unifies the entire operational, financial, and organizational lifecycle of a workforce—connecting who works (HRIS & Talent), where and when they work (Workforce Management & Biometrics), how they are paid (Payroll & Statutory Tax), what tools they use (IT Assets & Licenses), and how decisions are modeled (Workforce Analytics & Workforce Planning).

faqs.q: What is Workforce Planning and how does it work?
faqs.a: Workforce Planning is an embedded organizational simulation sandbox. It mirrors your company's actual organizational structure, compensation ledgers, and operational shift rules. Executive leadership can model restructuring scenarios—such as a 10% department headcount reduction, merging business units, or opening regional branches—and the engine calculates real-time P&L savings, statutory severance liabilities, and operational skill deficits before changes are committed.

faqs.q: How does workflow automation work in SpotSign AI?
faqs.a: SpotSign AI is powered by purpose-built workflow automations operating across 7 functional domains: employee helpdesk case routing, attrition risk reporting, pre-payroll anomaly detection, workforce demand forecasting, resume screening and gap analysis, job description and interview rubric generation, and scheduled executive reporting.

faqs.q: Does SpotSign AI support Indian payroll and statutory tax compliance?
faqs.a: Yes. SpotSign AI provides deep native support for Indian payroll including Section 192 TDS under both Old and New tax regimes, Form 12BB investment proof workflows, automated generation of Electronic Challan cum Return (ECR) files for EPFO, ESIC monthly contribution files, State-wise Professional Tax (PT) calculations, Labor Welfare Fund (LWF), and automated generation of digitally signed Form 16 Part A and Part B certificates.

faqs.q: Can SpotSign AI run payroll for both white-collar corporate employees and blue-collar factory workers?
faqs.a: Yes. The platform's dual-workforce engine allows processing salaried corporate employees on annual CTC packages alongside industrial plant workers, maritime crew, and contract labor operating under daily-rate, shift-rate, piece-rate (e.g., kilograms processed), and hourly overtime models within unified or segregated payroll batches.

faqs.q: Which biometric attendance hardware devices does SpotSign AI integrate with?
faqs.a: SpotSign AI provides native integration agents for major industry biometric terminals including eSSL, ZKTeco, Matrix, Realtime, and Suprema. Devices stream attendance punches in real time with local offline caching to prevent punch loss during network outages.

faqs.q: How does SpotSign AI manage complex shift rotations and overtime limits?
faqs.a: The Workforce Management engine supports 24/7 rotational shifts, split shifts for hospitality, and night shifts with automated allowance calculations. Built-in statutory rule engines prevent scheduled shifts that violate the 48-hour statutory weekly cap under the Factories Act or international maritime STCW rest mandates (minimum 77 hours rest per week).

faqs.q: What are the 19 specialized industry packs?
faqs.a: SpotSign AI includes 19 dedicated vertical packs with pre-configured departments, roles, shift rules, and compliance workflows: Shipping & Maritime, Seafood Processing, Logistics & Freight, Manufacturing, Chemical & Hazardous Operations, Healthcare, Hospitality, Fisheries & Aquaculture, Cargo Forwarding, Retail & E-Commerce, Fuel Stations, Cab Aggregators, Field Workforce, Automobile Services, Travel & Tourism, School & University, ITES, BPO Call Centers, and Information Technology.

SpotSign AI uses secure data separation, role-based access controls, enterprise authentication supporting Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID SSO, and detailed audit logging across administrative transactions.

faqs.q: How does SpotSign AI integrate with corporate finance and General Ledger (GL)?
faqs.a: Upon payroll finalization, SpotSign AI automatically generates balanced double-entry accounting journals mapped to your corporate chart of accounts (COA), posting salary expenditures, statutory liabilities, and cost-center allocations directly into ERP systems like SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, or Tally.
